blackjack.title: Blackjack | Idaho Lottery
blackjack.rules: An ace and a ten of any kind bring about this game’s moniker - Blackjack. Twenty-one. There’s a certain magic to the name and the number. Especially with cards. And to play, you only need stop by your nearest Idaho Lottery retailer and pick up this $5 InstaPlay game.In Blackjack, players receive nine hands of two cards each. If the total in any of the YOUR HANDS is higher than the DEALER’S TOTAL you win the prize shown for that hand. Add up the total number of hands that beat the Dealer’s Total, and you win the prize shown in the PRIZE LEGEND. Win on every hand and you win the game’s top prize of $30,000. Each hand is played separately.Trying Blackjack is as easy as visiting your Idaho Lottery retailer. And who knows, you might walk away with the game’s top prize of $30,000!
